title: The Compass of the Lower Danube
author: Casper Amberdale
blurb: Mirabel Sandoval, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
